entries.en: In 2007, Angelo Mastropietro was in the woods in Worcestershire, UK when it started to rain.
entries.zh: 2007 年，安杰洛·马斯特罗皮耶特罗在英国伍斯特郡的树林里，当时下起了雨。

entries.en: He looked for a place to keep dry and he discovered a cave house!
entries.zh: 他找地方躲雨，结果发现了一座洞穴屋！

entries.en: The cave house was 800 years old.
entries.zh: 这座洞穴屋有 800 年的历史。

entries.en: People lived in the rock-house for hundreds of years, but from about 1962, no one lived there and the house stayed empty.
entries.zh: 人们在这座岩屋里住了几百年，但从大约 1962 年起就没人住了，房子一直空着。

entries.en: Angelo liked the rock-house very much.
entries.zh: 安杰洛非常喜欢这座岩屋。

entries.en: He looked into the possibility of buying it.
entries.zh: 他认真考虑了把它买下来的可能性。

entries.en: It was for sale and in 2010 he decided to get it.
entries.zh: 它正在出售，2010 年他决定把它买下。

entries.en: After that, he started to cut into the rock and to rebuild and modernise the house.
entries.zh: 之后，他开始凿岩石，重建并把房子现代化。

entries.en: Angelo (who is English, even though his name is Italian) finished the house in nine months.
entries.zh: 安杰洛（他是英国人，尽管名字是意大利式的）用九个月完成了这座房子。

entries.en: He was a businessman before he started the house, and before 2007 he was quite ill, so he wanted a place where it was possible for him to live in a happy and healthy way.
entries.zh: 他在开始建房子之前是个商人，2007 年前他身体相当不好，所以他想要一个能让自己快乐健康生活的地方。

entries.en: He realised that he didn’t need to live in a huge apartment and that being closer to nature could help him feel better.
entries.zh: 他意识到自己不必住在大公寓里，更亲近大自然能让他感觉更好。

entries.en: He worked for over a thousand hours from beginning to end, and he used £160,000 to buy the house and all the things that he needed.
entries.zh: 他从开头到结尾干了一千多个小时，还花了 160,000 英镑买下房子和所需的一切东西。

entries.en: He planned everything himself, he moved about 80 tons of rock himself and he painted the house.
entries.zh: 他自己规划了一切，自己搬了大约 80 吨岩石，还亲手粉刷了房子。

entries.en: Angelo tried to make a comfortable place to live.
entries.zh: 安杰洛努力打造一个舒适的住所。

entries.en: The house has electricity, hot water and wi-fi, and there is heating under the floors of the rooms.
entries.zh: 房子里有电、热水和无线网络，房间地板下还有暖气。

entries.en: Angelo opened a deep hole 80 metres under the house to get natural water.
entries.zh: 安杰洛在房子地下 80 米处打了一口深井来取天然水。

entries.en: The house is not huge.
entries.zh: 房子并不大。

entries.en: It is about 65 m2, with one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom with a shower.
entries.zh: 它大约 65 平方米，有一间卧室、一间客厅、一间厨房和一间带淋浴的浴室。

entries.en: Angelo doesn’t live there all the time, but he uses the house as a place to go to sometimes, to get away from his busy city life.
entries.zh: 安杰洛并不一直住在那里，而是把它当作一个偶尔去住的地方，逃离忙碌的城市生活。

entries.en: It’s also possible to rent the house and to stay there for a weekend or more.
entries.zh: 这座房子也可以出租，让人在那里住一个周末或更久。

entries.en: This means that other people are able to enjoy Angelo’s happy house and maybe escape from their busy lives for a few days, too.
entries.zh: 这意味着其他人也能享受安杰洛的快乐小屋，也许还能逃离他们忙碌的生活几天。
